notes: Every record is a name that appears in neither the 776-artist baseline nor the two Wikidata candidate files (normalised name match).

Punjabi records come from Wikipedia biographies whose lead or infobox explicitly states bhangra / Punjabi folk / Punjabi pop / Punjabi-language music, or from the Bhangra (music) musicians and musical-groups categories.

Indian-indie records come from Wikipedia articles with explicit Indian rock/indie/alternative genre fields, or from Rolling Stone India independent-music lists (2019-2025) where each entry names the artist and describes the release.

Mainstream playback singers and film composers were excluded from indian-indie (e.g. the Wikidata candidate file's Asha Bhosle, Alka Yagnik, Udit Narayan, Himesh Reshammiya, Indio Solari entries were treated as query noise and not reused).
matched_genres are keyword tags taken from the cited source text, not inferred from the artist name.
